title: rust-mutants touched v1
description: What the guards of an instrumented tree recorded on the run that verified its baseline: which of each target's tests reached which mutation, which sites were reached where nothing named a test, and which targets said nothing this run can route by. A target absent from `targets` and named in `limitations` is one every test of which reaches every mutation in it. `narrowing` says which mutants the tree could record anything about, without which an absence in `bodies` or `infected` says nothing at all.

targets.description: Every target whose guards recorded, by identity.

limitations.description: Why a target the run built is not in `targets`, as `<limitation>:<target>`.

narrowing.description: Which of the records above are facts about which mutant. Every record here is an absence saying something, and an absence says nothing unless the tree carried the call that would have broken it.

compared.description: Every mutant whose guard evaluates its two branches, by dense catalog index, so `infected` is a fact about it.

bodies.description: The marker each mutant's branch proof rests on, by dense catalog index, keeping only the markers the instrumenter wrote; a body inside a guard's own site takes none.

target.description: What one target's guards recorded, and which of its tests ran to record it.

reached.description: The mutant sites each test reached.

bodies.description: The branch bodies each test entered, by the index of the marker at the body's first statement.

infected.description: The mutations each test saw its guard's two branches differ over.

ran.description: Every test the baseline ran, which is what a report nothing could attribute is about.

seen.description: One kind of thing the guards report, by the thread that reported it.

tests.description: What each named test of this target reported, as dense catalog indices.

loose.description: What was reported where nothing named a test, which is therefore about every test of the target.
